::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
A one-page summary of [Chapter 1 — Limits](../limits/index.qmd) and
[Chapter 2 — Derivatives](../derivatives/index.qmd) for quick lookup. Numbers in
brackets point to the full statement in *APEX Calculus*. Throughout,
$\lim_{x\to c} f(x) = L$ and $\lim_{x\to c} g(x) = K$.
:::

## Limits

::: {layout-ncol=2}

| Limit law [1.3.1] | |
|---|---|
| Constant, identity | $\lim b = b,\;\; \lim x = c$ |
| Sum / difference | $\lim (f \pm g) = L \pm K$ |
| Scalar multiple | $\lim b f = bL$ |
| Product | $\lim f g = LK$ |
| Quotient | $\lim f/g = L/K \;\; (K \neq 0)$ |
| Power | $\lim f^n = L^n$ |
| Root | $\lim \sqrt[n]{f} = \sqrt[n]{L} \;\;$ ($n$ odd or $L \geq 0$) |
| Composition [1.3.2] | $\lim g(f(x)) = g(L)$ if $g$ is continuous at $L$ |

| Special limits [1.3.6] | |
|---|---|
| $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to 0} \frac{\sin x}{x}$ | $1$ |
| $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to 0} \frac{\cos x - 1}{x}$ | $0$ |
| $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to 0} (1 + x)^{1/x}$ | $e$ |
| $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to 0} \frac{e^x - 1}{x}$ | $1$ |
| $\displaystyle\lim_{x\to\pm\infty} \frac{1}{x^n}$ [1.5.1] | $0 \;\; (n > 0)$ |

:::

**Direct substitution.** For polynomials, rational functions (denominator $\neq 0$),
$\sin, \cos, \tan, \csc, \sec, \cot, a^x, \ln x, \sqrt[n]{x}$:
$\lim_{x\to c} f(x) = f(c)$ for $c$ in the domain [1.3.3, 1.3.4]. If $f = g$
except at $c$, they have the same limit at $c$ [1.3.7].

**Rational functions at $\pm\infty$** [Key Idea 1.5.2], with
$f(x) = \dfrac{a_n x^n + \cdots + a_0}{b_m x^m + \cdots + b_0}$:

| Degrees | $\lim_{x\to\pm\infty} f(x)$ |
|---|---|
| $n = m$ (same degree) | $a_n / b_m$ |
| $n < m$ (bottom-heavy) | $0$ |
| $n > m$ (top-heavy) | infinite |

| Concept | Condition |
|---|---|
| Two-sided limit exists [1.4.1] | $\lim_{x\to c^-} f = \lim_{x\to c^+} f = L$ |
| Vertical asymptote at $x = c$ [1.5.2] | a limit (one- or two-sided) at $c$ is $\pm\infty$ |
| Horizontal asymptote at $y = L$ [1.5.4] | $\lim_{x\to\infty} f = L$ or $\lim_{x\to-\infty} f = L$ |

## Continuity

| | |
|---|---|
| Continuous at $c$ [1.6.1] | $\lim_{x\to c} f(x) = f(c)$ |
| Continuous on $[a, b]$ [1.6.3] | continuous on $(a, b)$, right continuous at $a$, left continuous at $b$ |
| Stays continuous [1.6.1, 1.6.2] | $f \pm g$, $cf$, $fg$, $f/g$ ($g \neq 0$), $f^n$, $\sqrt[n]{f}$, and compositions $g \circ f$ |
| Intermediate Value Theorem [1.6.4] | $f$ continuous on $[a, b]$, $y$ between $f(a)$ and $f(b)$ $\Rightarrow$ $f(c) = y$ for some $c \in (a, b)$ |

## Derivatives

$$
f'(x) = \lim_{h\to 0} \frac{f(x + h) - f(x)}{h}
\qquad
f'(x) = y' = \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{df}{dx}
\qquad
\text{tangent at } c:\; \ell(x) = f'(c)(x - c) + f(c)
$$

Position $s(t)$ → velocity $s'(t)$ → acceleration $s''(t)$ [Key Idea 2.2.1].

::: {layout-ncol=2}

| Rule | Formula |
|---|---|
| Constant [2.3.1] | $(c)' = 0$ |
| Power [2.3.1] | $(x^n)' = n x^{n-1}$ |
| Constant multiple [2.3.2] | $(cf)' = c f'$ |
| Sum / difference [2.3.2] | $(f \pm g)' = f' \pm g'$ |
| Product [2.4.1] | $(fg)' = f g' + f' g$ |
| Quotient [2.4.2] | $\left(\dfrac{f}{g}\right)' = \dfrac{g f' - f g'}{g^2}$ |
| Chain [2.5.1] | $\big(f(g(x))\big)' = f'(g(x))\, g'(x)$ |
| Generalized power [2.5.2] | $\big(g(x)^n\big)' = n\, g(x)^{n-1} g'(x)$ |

| $f(x)$ | $f'(x)$ [2.6.1] |
|---|---|
| $e^x$ | $e^x$ |
| $\ln x$ | $1/x$ |
| $\sin x$ | $\cos x$ |
| $\cos x$ | $-\sin x$ |
| $\tan x$ | $\sec^2 x$ |
| $\cot x$ | $-\csc^2 x$ |
| $\sec x$ | $\sec x \tan x$ |
| $\csc x$ | $-\csc x \cot x$ |

:::
